make_device_from_string: create a torch.device object from a device string like 'cuda' or 'cpu' with automatic index resolution
make_device_from_torch_device: convert a torch.device object to a resolved device with explicit CUDA index if needed
get_device_from_tensor: get the device of a torch.Tensor and return it as a torch.device object
get_device_with_fallback: get the device from a tensor or fall back to a specified default or CPU
get_device_override: override the device detection by providing an explicit device string or torch.device
